2609.24480.title: Fathom-Vaidya: Advancing Medical Reasoning with Rubric-Based Rewards
2609.24480.paper_summary: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in healthcare requires robust performance across two complementary dimensions - diagnostic reasoning: the convergent, evidence-driven task of inferring a patient's condition from clinical data to produce a diagnosis, and clinical healthcare reasoning: the broader, navigational judgment required to communicate, plan, and adapt across multi-turn clinical interactions where a single correct answer may not exist. Recent benchmarks such as HealthBench and MedXpertQA reveal persistent weaknesses in both areas, exposing failures in complex diagnostic scenarios and limitations in contextual, patient-centered dialogue. We introduce a sequential training framework that targets these facets using synthetic data and rubric-based reinforcement learning. First, we improve diagnostic reasoning using MedBullets-derived questions with rule- and rubric-guided Reinforcement Learning (RL). We then shift to clinical reasoning by generating 5.3k synthetic multi-turn scenarios, each paired with multi-dimensional rubrics to comprehensively assess the response. This approach yields over 10% improvement on MedXpertQA, and our 30B model achieves 50.1% accuracy on HealthBench-Hard, surpassing proprietary baselines including GPT-5 (thinking). Our results show that targeted synthetic datasets and rubric-based training can systematically improve both diagnostic and interactive clinical reasoning in medical LLMs.
2609.24480.paper_summary_zh: 在醫療保健中部署大型語言模型（LLMs）需要在兩個互補的維度上具備穩健的性能——診斷推理：從臨床數據中推斷患者狀況以產生診斷的收斂性、以證據為驅動的任務，以及臨床醫療推理：在多輪臨床互動中所需的更廣泛的導航判斷，這些互動中可能不存在單一正確答案。最近的基準測試，如HealthBench和MedXpertQA，揭示了這兩個領域持續存在的弱點，暴露了在複雜診斷場景中的失敗以及在以患者為中心的對話中的限制。我們引入了一個針對這些方面的序列訓練框架，使用合成數據和基於評分標準的強化學習。首先，我們使用來自MedBullets的問題，通過規則和評分標準引導的強化學習（RL）來改善診斷推理。然後，我們轉向臨床推理，生成5.3k個合成的多輪場景，每個場景都配有多維評分標準，以全面評估回應。這種方法在MedXpertQA上實現了超過10%的改進，而我們的30B模型在HealthBench-Hard上達到了50.1%的準確率，超過了包括GPT-5（思考）在內的專有基準。我們的結果顯示，針對性的合成數據集和基於評分標準的訓練可以系統性地改善醫療LLMs中的診斷和互動臨床推理。
